findings.issue_text: UsernamePasswordForm.isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(user) requires user != null, inverting the previous condition so webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context) is never called for the anonymous first-login page, breaking the conditional-UI passkey form on normal logins and existing tests like passwordLoginWithExternalKey

During re-authentication (context.getUser() != null), the conditional passkey UI is enabled for any user when the realm policy has passkeys on, without checking the user has a webauthn-passwordless credential, allowing a different user's passkey to be presented on an auth session already bound to the re-authenticating user

reauthenticationOfUserWithoutPasskey test only covers realm-level passkeysEnabled=false, not the scenario its comment describes (passkeys enabled, user has no passkey), and there is no test that re-authentication rejects a passkey belonging to a different user
WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators overrides a superclass method without @Override, so signature drift in WebAuthnAuthenticator would silently make it a new method

AuthenticatorUtils (util package) statically imports USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH from AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator (browser package), creating a package cycle and forcing the constant to be public; the constant or helper should move to a shared location

isUserAlreadySetBeforeUsernamePasswordAuth(context) in AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator appears to be unused after the replaced block and duplicates the new AuthenticatorUtils helper; it should be removed or delegate to it

goldens.comment: In UsernameForm.authenticate(), isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() is called without passing the required UserModel parameter.

With isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user) requiring user != null, authenticate(...) will not call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context) on the initial login page where context.getUser() is still null, so conditional passkey UI will not be set up for first-time passkey login. Consider whether this should also be enabled when no user has been selected yet so ID-less passkey authentication on the initial login form continues to work.

WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator.shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators overrides a superclass method without @Override, so signature drift in WebAuthnAuthenticator would silently make it a new method

adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `WebAuthnAuthenticator` introduces `protected boolean shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators(AuthenticationFlowContext context)` and `WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator` defines a method with the same signature, so it will override correctly today even without `@Override`. The proposed issue (“signature drift would silently make it a new method”) is a hypothetical future-maintainability concern rather than a verifiable defect introduced by this diff; the code currently compiles/behaves as intended given matching signatures.

adjudication_records.issue_text: AuthenticatorUtils (util package) statically imports USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH from AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator (browser package), creating a package cycle and forcing the constant to be public; the constant or helper should move to a shared location

adjudication.rationale: The diff does introduce a new dependency from `org.keycloak.authentication.authenticators.util.AuthenticatorUtils` to `org.keycloak.authentication.authenticators.browser.AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator` via `import static ...USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH`, and the constant was widened from `protected` to `public` to allow this. However, this does not create a Java compile-time/package-cycle error (Java packages are not modules), nor is it a correctness/security bug by itself; it’s primarily an architectural/layering concern and API surface change (more permissive), which is not a clearly verifiable defect from the diff alone.

adjudication_records.issue_text: isUserAlreadySetBeforeUsernamePasswordAuth(context) in AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator appears to be unused after the replaced block and duplicates the new AuthenticatorUtils helper; it should be removed or delegate to it

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows only that one call site of `isUserAlreadySetBeforeUsernamePasswordAuth(context)` was replaced with `AuthenticatorUtils.setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError(context)`. It does not show the definition of `isUserAlreadySetBeforeUsernamePasswordAuth` nor whether it is now unused elsewhere in `AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator`, so the “unused” claim is not verifiable from the diff alone. Even if it were now unused, that would be dead-code cleanup/refactoring rather than a clear correctness/security defect introduced by the change.
